description: An empty TRANFILE, which fires defect 1 on the first pass. The first READ reports '10', so 1000-TRANFILE-GET-NEXT moves 'Y' to END-OF-FILE - but the range test at :173-174 runs BEFORE the END-OF-FILE test at :179, and it runs against a TRAN-RECORD no read has ever filled. That area holds spaces, spaces collate below any digit, so the test fails and NEXT SENTENCE leaves the loop before the end-of-file arm at :197 can be reached. The result is that an empty input produces a completely empty report rather than a header and a pair of zero totals - no record is written, and RETURN-CODE is 0. DATEPARM is still read, so the 'Reporting from' line is displayed.
